## access

- `bigon_corners(d::HeegaardDrawing) -> Tuple{Vararg{Tuple{Int,Int}}}` — Return the recorded crossing-label pairs at the corners of a Heegaard drawing's bigons. [contract](bigon_corners.md)
- `crossing_curves(d::HeegaardDrawing, label::Integer) -> NamedTuple` — Return the alpha and beta curve names recorded at a crossing of a Heegaard drawing. [contract](crossing_curves.md)
- `curve_incidents(d::HeegaardDrawing, name::AbstractString) -> NamedTuple` — Return the edge and crossing keys incident to a named curve in a Heegaard drawing. [contract](curve_incidents.md)
- `element_at(d::HeegaardDrawing, primitive_id::Integer, point_index::Integer) -> DrawingElement` — Return the semantic drawing element owning a selected primitive point. [contract](element_at.md)
- `face_boundary(d::HeegaardDrawing, name::AbstractString) -> Tuple` — Return the stored oriented edge boundary of a named face in a Heegaard drawing. [contract](face_boundary.md)
- `resolved_style(d::HeegaardDrawing, el::DrawingElement) -> Dict{Symbol,Any}` — Resolve the current visual attributes of one semantic drawing element. [contract](resolved_style.md)

## condition

- `check_layout(layout::LinkLayout; …) -> Vector{LayoutDiagnostic}` — Return diagnostics for selected geometric properties of a routed link diagram. [contract](check_layout.md)
- `check_layout(v::VirtualLink; …) -> Vector{LayoutDiagnostic}` — Return geometric diagnostics for an orthogonal layout of a virtual-link diagram. [contract](check_layout.md)
- `failing_rules(x; …) -> Vector{Symbol}` — List the selected geometric property names that report layout errors. [contract](failing_rules.md)
- `is_valid_layout(x; …) -> Bool` — Test whether the selected layout predicates report no error diagnostic. [contract](is_valid_layout.md)

## construct

- `DrawingElement(kind, key, input, drawn, …) -> DrawingElement` — Store one semantic element and its part references in a Heegaard drawing. [contract](DrawingElement.md)
- `DrawingPrimitive(id, shape, points, closed) -> DrawingPrimitive` — Store one geometric part of a Heegaard drawing. [contract](DrawingPrimitive.md)
- `EdgeLayout(id, points, tail, head, …) -> EdgeLayout` — Store the routed polyline and incidence metadata of a PD edge. [contract](EdgeLayout.md)
- `LayoutDiagnostic(rule, severity, message; …) -> LayoutDiagnostic` — Store one diagnostic about a routed link diagram's geometry. [contract](LayoutDiagnostic.md)
- `minimal_bending_numbers(pd::AbstractMatrix{<:Integer}) -> Vector{Int}` — Return signed edge bend counts minimizing the specified region-flow model. [contract](minimal_bending_numbers.md)
- `planarize_virtual_gauss(real_gauss, real_orientation; …) -> Tuple` — Return Gauss components and crossing signs with virtual visits inserted for drawing a closed real Gauss presentation. [contract](planarize_virtual_gauss.md)
- `planarize_virtual_gauss_layer8(real_gauss, real_orientation; …) -> Tuple` — Return the Gauss components and crossing signs assigned to a closed real Gauss presentation by the Layer8 route. [contract](planarize_virtual_gauss_layer8.md)
